blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding the internal routing of visual concepts is crucial for the safe and controllable adaptation of generative models. While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework to localize where and when specific concepts emerge within autoregressive models. Driven by the native coarse-to-fine nature of next-scale generation, our method precisely maps conceptual knowledge across three distinct dimensions: Layer, Scale, and Position. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. Extensive probing on image and video autoregressive models like Infinity, HunyuanImage-3.0, and InfinityStar shows that the localized positions are both interpretable and causally related to concept emergence. Building on these insights, we apply our localization method to three key applications: concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial concept injection. Experiments demonstrate that our targeted intervention achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially reducing computational overhead while preserving benign utility. Overall, our findings offer insights into how conceptual knowledge is routed during autoregressive generation, introducing a practical pathway for more interpretable, efficient, and secure adaptation.
blocks.zh: 了解视觉概念的内部路径对基因模型的安全和可控制的适应至关重要。 虽然概念本地化在扩散模型中被广泛研究,但正在形成的下级视觉自递模型的范式基本上仍未被探索. 在本文中,我们介绍了LoCo,这是第一个模型不可知性框架,用于在自递性模型中出现具体概念的地方和时间本地化. 由下一代的原始粗糙至细小的性质驱动,我们的方法精确地绘制了三个不同维度的概念知识:地层、尺度和位置。 为了系统地确定和评价概念的路径,不带上下文的偏差,我们提出LoCo Bench,一个涵盖10个不同类别的综合数据集。 对"无限","HunyuanImage-3.0"和"无限之星"等图像和视频自相递进模型的广泛探究表明,本地化位置既可被解释,又与概念的出现有因果关系. 在这些洞察力的基础上,我们把本地化方法应用到三个关键应用上:概念去除,模型个性化,和对抗性的概念注入. 实验表明,我们有针对性的干预取得了最新业绩,大大减少了计算间接费用,同时保持了良性效用。 总体而言,我们的调查结果提供了对概念知识如何在自动递减生成过程中的路由的深刻见解,为更可解释、高效和安全的适应引入了实用途径。

blocks.en: The landscape of text-to-image (T2I) and text-to-video (T2V) generation has evolved at breakneck speed. The field rapidly transitioned from foundational U-Net architectures Rombach et al. (2022) ; Hertz et al. (2022) to the highly scalable era of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) Peebles and Xie (2023) ; Labs et al. (2025) . Recently, Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models Tian et al. (2024) ; Han et al. (2025) ; Cao et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2025) have emerged as a new paradigm. By treating visual generation as a next-scale coarse-to-fine prediction task Tian et al. (2024) , VAR models have achieved remarkable success and set new standards for generation quality.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像(T2I)和文本到视频(T2V)生成的地貌以突破速度演变. 球场从基础的U-Net建筑隆巴赫等(2022年);赫兹等(2022年)迅速过渡到高度可扩展的分化变形器(DiTs) Peebles和Xie等(2023年);Labs等(2025年). 最近,视觉自递(VAR)模型"天等" (2024年);"汉等" (2025年);"曹等" (2025年);"刘等" (2025年) 已经成为一种新的范式. 通过将视觉生成视为下个尺度的粗到精的预测任务"天等" (2024),VAR模型取得了显著的成功并制定了生成质量的新标准.

blocks.en: With access to such powerful pretrained models, it is crucial to explore their potential for applications beyond mere generation. A growing body of work has focused on localizing different types of concept and knowledge within these models to enable more targeted usage Hertz et al. (2022) ; Tumanyan et al. (2023) ; Kumari et al. (2023a) . For example, prior studies demonstrate that cross-attention layers are key to incorporating prompt compositional information, while structural information is often concentrated in the self-attention modules of UNet-based architectures Hertz et al. (2022) ; Liu et al. (2024) . Such internal understanding plays a critical role in practical applications. Several works Gandikota et al. (2023a) ; Gandikota et al. (2024) ; Jiang et al. (2026) have shown that generative models often memorize unsafe or unwanted content (e.g., Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) or copyrighted content), and designed methods for concept erasure , which aim to forget these specific targets while preserving overall generation utility. Conversely, tasks like model personalization Ruiz et al. (2023) and adversarial concept injection Jang et al. (2025) require injecting novel subjects into diverse scenes using minimal reference data. In both scenarios, localizing concepts within the model is crucial for enabling targeted interventions that make fine-tuning highly efficient while preserving the model’s prior capabilities and overall generation quality.
blocks.zh: 有了这种经过事先培训的强大模型,关键是探索其应用的潜力,而不仅仅是一代人。 越来越多的工作侧重于在这些模型中将不同类型的概念和知识本地化,以便能够更有针对性的使用Hertz等人(2022年);Tumanyan等人(2023年);Kumari等人(2023年a年)。 例如,先前的研究表明,交叉关注层是纳入即时构成信息的关键,而结构信息则往往集中在UNet-based architectures Hertz等(2022);Liu等(2024)的自关注模块. 这种内部理解在实际应用中起关键作用. 一些作品"Gandikota等"(2023a);"Gandikota等"(2024);"Jiang等"(2026)都表明,基因模型常常会记住不安全或不必要的内容(如"不安全工作"(NSFW)或有版权的内容),并设计了概念去除的方法,目的是在保留整体生成效用的同时忘记这些具体目标. 相反,类似模型个性化Ruiz等人(2023年)和对抗性概念注入Jang等人的任务. (2025年)要求使用最低限度的参考数据将小说主题注入到各种场景中. 在这两种情况下,使模型中的概念本地化对于促成目标明确的干预至关重要,这些干预可以使精细调整高效,同时保持模型的先前能力和总体生成质量。

blocks.en: While extensive research has explored concept localization in UNet and DiT architectures Zarei et al. (2025) ; Hertz et al. (2022) ; Tumanyan et al. (2023) ; Zarei et al. (2024b) , emerging VAR models remain largely underexplored. Unlike classical generative models, VAR models construct visual representations progressively from coarse, low-resolution scales to fine, high-resolution details. Therefore, we find that directly applying layer-wise localization methods designed for diffusion models Zarei et al. (2025) ; Basu et al. (2024b) proves highly sub-optimal, as they ignore this dynamic multi-scale mechanism, leading to poor localization precision. Furthermore, our probing reveals a non-trivial phenomenon: concepts do not reside in a single neural layer; they first anchor at critical coarse scales and manifest only at sparse spatial query positions. Capturing this complex emergence requires a joint, multi-dimensional approach.
blocks.zh: 虽然广泛研究了UNet和DiT架构中的概念本地化(2025年);Hertz等(2022年);Tumanyan等(2023年);Zarei等(2024年b),但新兴的VAR模型仍然基本没有得到充分利用. 与古典基因模型不同的是,VAR模型构建视觉表现,从粗糙,低分辨率的尺度逐渐地到细而高的分辨率细节. 因此,我们发现,直接应用为扩散模型Zarei等人(2025年);Basu等人(2024年b年)设计的分层定位方法证明高度不理想,因为它们忽略了这种动态多尺度机制,导致分层精确度差. 此外,我们的探测揭示出一种非三角现象:概念并不存在于单一神经层;它们首先被固定在很粗的尺度上,只在空间查询位置上出现。 抓住这种复杂的出现需要联合多维的方法.

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce LoCo ( Lo calizing Co ncepts), an automatic and model-agnostic localization framework tailored for VAR models (Figure 1 ). Driven by the progressive nature of next-scale generation, LoCo precisely maps conceptual knowledge by analyzing internal attention dynamics. Specifically, it computes the attention response for each spatial query position throughout the generation process to pinpoint the Top- K K most critical ( 𝙻𝚊𝚢𝚎𝚛 , 𝚂𝚌𝚊𝚕𝚎 , 𝙿𝚘𝚜𝚒𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗 ) \mathtt{(Layer,Scale,Position)} triplets responsible for the target concept. By exclusively intervening on these highly localized routes, we can execute targeted downstream editing while leaving the vast majority of model parameters untouched.
blocks.zh: 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了LoCo(Lo Calization Co ncepts),这是一个适合VAR模型的自动和模型不可知本地化框架(图1)。 在下一代的渐进性驱动下,LoCo通过分析内部关注动态,精确地绘制出概念知识. 具体而言,它计算整个生成过程中每个空间查询位置的注意力响应,以指定负责目标概念的Top-K最关键(层,缩放,位置)\matht{(Layer, Scale, Position)}三重体. 通过完全干预这些高度本地化的路线,我们可以进行有针对性的下游编辑,同时使绝大多数模型参数不受影响.

blocks.en: Existing public datasets (e.g., I2P Schramowski et al. (2023) ) focus on single tasks and lack the structured, paired prompts required to isolate concepts and eliminate context bias. To bridge this gap, we propose LoCoBench , a large-scale probing dataset explicitly designed to evaluate concept routing, encompassing 10 diverse categories, 1,467 entities, and over 60K prompts. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art models (Infinity Han et al. (2025) , HunyuanImage-3.0 Cao et al. (2025) , and InfinityStar Liu et al. (2025) ) demonstrate that LoCo consistently outperforms full-parameter fine-tuning across downstream applications. Notably, strictly intervening on just the top 5% of localized positions yields superior task performance and minimal contextual interference, while reducing memory usage by 38.5% and training time by 82.9%.

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to systematically investigate concept localization in VAR models. In summary, our main contributions are: • We introduce LoCo , a novel localization framework specifically designed for the progressive generation dynamics of VAR models. It precisely identifies where concepts emerge by locating the exact Layer, Scale, and Position dimensions. • We present LoCoBench , a large-scale probing dataset comprising 10 categories, 1,467 entities, and over 60K paired prompts. It features rigorous prompt shuffling to eliminate context bias, enabling robust localization and evaluation of concept routing. • Building on this localization, we demonstrate practical applications for concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial injection. Our ultra-sparse targeted fine-tuning achieves state-of-the-art task performance, reducing memory usage by 38.5% and training time by 82.9%.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,我们首先系统地调查VAR模型中的概念本地化。 总而言之,我们的主要贡献是: • 我们介绍LoCo,这是专门为VAR模型的渐进生成动力而设计的一个新的本地化框架. 它通过定位精确的地层、尺度和位置等维度,精确地确定了概念的出现之处。 我们介绍LoCo Bench, 由10个类别、1 467个实体和超过60K对接的提示组成的大规模检测数据集。 它的特点是迅速进行严格打乱,以消除上下文的偏差,从而能够对概念路线进行强有力的本地化和评价。 • 在这种本地化的基础上,我们展示了概念消除、模式个性化和对抗性注射的实际应用。 我们的超散射目标微调实现了最先进的任务性能,将内存使用率减少了38.5%,培训时间减少了82.9%.

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Autoregressive Generation Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉自动递减型号

blocks.en: To unify multimodal understanding and generation within a single framework, autoregressive models first turn images and videos into discrete tokens van den Oord et al. (2017) . Early models generate these tokens in a flat 1D raster order, much like reading text Ramesh et al. (2021) ; Yu et al. (2024) ; Fan et al. (2024) . Later systems scale this 1D pipeline for powerful, unified visual generation Chen et al. (2025) ; Deng et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2024c) ; Wang et al. (2024d) . However, flattening spatial data creates bottlenecks in image quality and efficiency. Recently, VAR models solve this by predicting the next scale instead of the next token Tian et al. (2024) . This coarse-to-fine process drastically improves generation quality and enables new control methods Li et al. (2024) ; Yao et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) . Building on this, Infinity Han et al. (2025) and HunyuanImage-3.0 Cao et al. (2025) achieve state-of-the-art T2I generation, while InfinityStar Liu et al. (2025) extends to T2V generation. We select these three recent models to represent the next-scale autoregressive family and demonstrate our method.

(2025)实现最先进的T2I一代,而"无限之星"刘等. (2025)延伸至T2V世代. 我们选择这三种最近的模型来代表下一个自相递进的家族,并展示出我们的方法.

blocks.en: 2.2 Interpretability of Generative Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 基因模型的可解释性

blocks.en: A rich literature explores the interpretability of generative models for storing concepts and controllable generation. In U-Net diffusion models, attention maps and targeted layers are used to interpret and control spatial features Hertz et al. (2022) ; Xie et al. (2023) ; Basu et al. (2024b) ; Basu et al. (2024a) ; Zarei et al. (2024b) . As architectures shift to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) Chen et al. (2023a) ; Labs et al. (2025) , recent works trace visual knowledge to critical blocks and use attention for saliency Zarei et al. (2025) ; Helbling et al. (2025) ; Avrahami et al. (2024) . Similarly, language models localize factual behavior to specific layers and activations Dai et al. (2022) ; Meng et al. (2022) ; Meng et al. (2023) . However, the interpretability of recent next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely underexplored. Our work fills this gap by providing the first interpretability framework that explicitly tracks concepts across layers, scales, and local positions.
blocks.zh: 丰富的文献探索了基因模型的可解释性,用于存储概念和可控生成. 在U-Net扩散模型中,注意地图和定向地层用于解释和控制空间特征Hertz等(2022年);Xie等(2023年);Basu等(2024b);Basu等(2024a年);Zarei等(2024b年)。 随着建筑转向分化变形器(DiTs) Chen等 (2023a) ; Labs等 (2025) ,近期作品将视觉知识追溯到关键块上,并使用关注度显赫的Zarei等 (2025) ; Helbling等 (2025); Avrahami等 (2024) . 同样,语言模型将事实行为本地化到特定的地层并活化出Dai等人(2022年);Meng等人(2022年);Meng等人(2023年). 然而,近期的下级视觉自递模型的可解释性仍然在很大程度上没有得到充分利用. 我们的工作填补了这一空白,提供了第一个可解释性框架,明确跟踪各级、各级和地方职位的概念。

blocks.en: 2.3 Concept Erasure, Personalization, and Adversarial Injection
blocks.zh: 2.3 概念Erasure、个性化和横向注射

blocks.en: Concept-level control is vital for content safety and personalized creation. First, concept erasure aims to remove unsafe or unwanted content. Extensive studies target U-Net Gandikota et al. (2023b) ; Kumari et al. (2023a) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) ; Gandikota et al. (2024) and DiT architectures Gao et al. (2025b) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ; Jiang et al. (2026) ; Fan et al. (2026) ; Jiang et al. (2025) ; Gao et al. (2025a) . However, erasure in autoregressive models is challenging, because error accumulation in discrete generation often leads to severe artifacts Zhong et al. (2026) . Recent works attempt targeted weight updates or activation steering Zhong et al. (2026) ; Fan et al. (2025) ; Chrabaszcz et al. (2026) . Second, model personalization preserves specific identities or styles during generation Ruiz et al. (2023) ; Gal et al. (2023) ; Kumari et al. (2023b) . Finally, adversarial injection uses backdoors or data poisoning to force malicious or branded outputs Chen et al. (2023b) ; An et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024a) ; Shan et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024b) ; Lu et al. (2024b) . Unlike previous works that tackle these challenges in isolation, we unify them by uncovering the interpretability and underlying concept routes within the autoregressive generation process.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Unlike classical raster-scan autoregression, next-scale VAR models Tian et al. (2024) generate images and videos progressively by predicting discrete residual token maps r s r_{s} across K K scales. At each scale s ∈ { 1 , … , K } s\in\{1,\dots,K\} , the model predicts the entire residual map r s r_{s} (with spatial-temporal size t s × h s × w s t_{s}\times h_{s}\times w_{s} ) in parallel, conditioned on the text prompt y y and coarser scales r < s r_{<s} . The continuous visual latent f s f_{s} is then reconstructed by aggregating and upsampling these discrete codes from early scales (which establish global layout) to later scales (which render fine-grained conceptual details). For a formal mathematical formulation of this process, please refer to Appendix A .

blocks.en: 3.1 LoCoBench : A Concept Probe Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 LoCo Bench: 概念探测数据集

blocks.en: To systematically study and evaluate the versatility and robustness of our localization method, we introduce a new probe dataset LoCoBench . It spans 10 distinct categories: safety, copyrights, artists, styles, celebrities, animals, places, brands, weapons, and substances concepts. These categories cover diverse visual semantics and represent key downstream tasks like concept erasure, model personalization and adversarial concept injection. In total, LoCoBench contains 1,467 concept entities, 28,230 training prompts and 37,800 evaluation prompts. For details on the dataset construction, statistics, and prompt examples, please refer to Appendix B .

blocks.zh: 3.2 本地化方法

blocks.en: Our goal is to identify exactly where VAR models encode specific semantic concepts. Given a prompt p i c p_{i}^{c} (e.g., “The Batman walking in a snowy forest” ), where c c denotes the target concept ( “The Batman” ), we aim to pinpoint the specific layers, scales, and local positions primarily responsible for representing c c . By localizing the internal representation of such concepts, we understand how information flows through coarse-to-fine visual grids. This directly enables targeted downstream interventions, such as concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial injection.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是准确确定 VAR 模型编码具体语义概念的位置. 鉴于p i c p _{i}^{c}(例如:"蝙蝠侠走入雪地森林"),其中c 表示目标概念 ("蝙蝠侠"),我们的目标是确定主要负责代表c 的特定地层,天平,以及当地职位. 通过将这种概念的内部表现本地化,我们了解信息如何通过粗细的视觉网格流动。 这直接促成了有针对性的下游干预,如概念消除、模式个性化和对抗性注射。

blocks.en: We leverage attention contribution Elhage et al. (2021) ; Dar et al. (2022) ; Zarei et al. (2024a) to track these concepts. At a given layer and scale, the attention contribution of a text token to a specific query position quantifies how strongly that text influences the local visual patch. We localize the exact positions where concept tokens exhibit high contribution. We adopt this signal because it provides a principled and intuitive way to trace how text conditions the generation of local structural and textural evidence. Furthermore, it is universally applicable across any autoregressive transformer utilizing cross-attention.

By swapping the inputs strictly at the concept’s core routing nodes, we successfully remove c c from the output while leaving the global scene structure and unrelated semantics fully intact.

blocks.en: 4 Applications
blocks.zh: 4 申请

blocks.en: We evaluate our localization framework on three practical downstream applications:
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们本地化框架的三个实用下游应用:

blocks.en: Concept Erasure. Concept erasure removes unsafe or copyrighted content from a generative model. We achieve this through two methods. First, our map enables training-free inference intervention. For a target concept, we identify its top- K K routed positions. During generation, we swap their cross-attention text conditions with a neutral anchor. This lightweight step acts as an immediate safety filter. It suppresses the concept while fully preserving the original scene.
blocks.zh: 概念Erasure。 概念去除从基因模型中删除不安全或有版权的内容. 我们通过两种方法实现这一目标。 首先,我们的地图允许无训练的推论干预。 对于一个目标概念,我们确定它的顶端 -K路由。 在一代人中,我们用中性锚交换他们的交叉注意力文本条件. 这个轻量级的台阶起到即时安全过滤的作用. 它在完全保留原作场景的同时压制了这个概念.

blocks.en: Second, we propose targeted LoRA fine-tuning Hu et al. (2021) for permanent erasure. Previous erasure methods (e.g., ESD Kumari et al. (2023a) ) fail in VAR models. This is because early errors compound progressively and collapse the generation space (Appendix Figure 7 b). Recent work uses conditional alignment Zhong et al. (2026) to prevent this error accumulation. However, updating the full model still causes noticeable visual shifts (Appendix Figure 7 c). We solve this by restricting the conditional alignment gradients exclusively to the top- K K localized routes. This ultra-sparse update permanently erases the concept without disrupting global image quality (Appendix Figure 7 d). For detailed derivations, please see Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh: 二是提出定点"LORA"微调"胡等"(2021)永久去除. 以前的去除法(如ESD Kumari等 (2023a))在VAR模型中失败. 这是因为早期出错逐渐复合并坍塌了生成空间(附录图7b). 最近的工作使用有条件的对齐钟等(2026年)来防止这种误差积累. 然而,更新完整的模型仍然会引起明显的视觉变化(附录图7c). 我们通过将有条件的对齐梯度限制在 K K 本地化路线来解决这个问题。 这种超平面更新永久地抹去这个概念而不会扰乱全球图像质量(附录图7d). 详细情况见附录C.1。

blocks.en: Model Personalization. Personalization generates images of a specific subject in novel contexts using minimal reference images. It typically uses DreamBooth Ruiz et al. (2023) . Instead of blindly fine-tuning the entire model, we use concept localization to guide the update process. Given a new subject, we infer its broad semantic class (e.g., “dog” ) and extract its localization map. We then restrict DreamBooth updates entirely to these identified layer-scale-position routes. This targeted intervention largely preserves prior knowledge and substantially reduces computational costs. It also shows superior prompt alignment in complex scenarios (see Section 5.2 and Appendix C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 模特个性化. 个性化用最小的参考图像在新语境中生成特定主题的图像. 一般使用DreamBooth Ruiz等 (2023). 与其盲目地微调整个模型,不如使用概念本地化来指导更新过程. 鉴于一个新的主题,我们推断其广义的语义类(如"狗")并取出其本地化地图. 然后我们把DreamBooth的更新 完全限制在这些识别的层级位置路线上。 这种有针对性的干预措施在很大程度上保留了先前的知识并大大减少了计算费用。 它还表明,在复杂情况下,情况更为迅速(见第5.2节和附录C.2)。

blocks.en: Adversarial Concept Injection. This task explores generative vulnerabilities by embedding hidden payloads into a model through data poisoning An et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024a) ; Shan et al. (2024) . These payloads include unauthorized brands or unsafe cues. Our framework provides a clear way to pinpoint the exact internal routes that make these attacks possible. By focusing malicious manipulation strictly on highly responsive nodes, we execute data-efficient injections. This shows that concept routes act as fundamental structural bottlenecks. They can be neutralized for safety or exploited for red-teaming (see Appendix C.3 ).
blocks.zh: 逆相概念注射. 这项任务通过数据毒害An等人(2024年);Wang等人(2024年a年)将隐藏的有效载荷嵌入模型来探索遗传脆弱性; 山等 (2024) (中文(简体) ). 这些有效载荷包括未经授权的品牌或不安全提示. 我们的框架提供了一个明确的方法,可以确定这些攻击的确切内部路线。 通过将恶意操纵严格集中在高响应度的节点上,我们实施数据高效注射. 这表明概念路线是根本性的结构瓶颈。 为了安全,它们可以被中和,也可以被利用来进行红队(见附录C.3)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.1 执行细节

blocks.en: Setup. We validate our framework on state-of-the-art next-scale VAR models. We select Infinity Han et al. (2025) and HunyuanImage-3.0 Cao et al. (2025) for image generation, and InfinityStar Liu et al. (2025) for video generation. By default, we intervene and fine-tune on the top 5% localized positions with LoRA Hu et al. (2021) . We generate images at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution spanning 10 scales, and videos at 720p resolution with 81 frames.
blocks.zh: 设相. 我们验证我们关于最新水平VAR模型的框架。 我们选择了Infinity Han等(2025年)和Hunyuanimage-3.0 Cao等(2025年)进行图像生成,InfinityStar Liu等(2025年)进行视频生成. 与LORA Hu等人(2021年)合作, 我们以512 × 512 512\times 512 分辨率生成图像,范围为10个尺度,视频以720p分辨率生成,有81个帧.

blocks.en: Baselines. We use concept erasure as our primary quantitative benchmark due to popularity. Currently, EAR Fan et al. (2025) , S-VARE Zhong et al. (2026) , and CAT Chrabaszcz et al. (2026) are the only erasure methods natively designed for VAR models (fine-tuning). To ensure a comprehensive evaluation, we also adapt leading diffusion/DiT-based methods (ESD Gandikota et al. (2023a) , MACE Lu et al. (2024a) , and EraseAnything Gao et al. (2025b) ) to VAR models, using conditional alignment in Section 4 for fine-tuning. For more implementation details, please refer to Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: 基线。 由于受欢迎,我们把概念消除作为我们的首要量化基准。 目前,EAR Fan等人(2025年),S-VARE Zhong等人(2026年)和CAT Chrabaszcz等人(2026年)是当地为VAR模型(fine-turn)所设计的唯一去除方法. 为了确保全面评估,我们还将主要传播/基于DiT的方法(ESD Gandikota等人(2023年a),MACE Lu等人(2024年a),以及EraseAnythinging Gao等人(2025年b))调整为VAR模型,利用第4节中的有条件调整来进行微调. 更多执行详情请参见附录D.1。

blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Evaluation on NSFW erasure. We evaluate nudity and violence erasure on 4,703 prompts from the I2P dataset, and report their respective FID and CLIP scores on MS-COCO to test utility preservation. Results of the original base models are presented for reference.
blocks.zh: 表1:对NSFW消除的评价。 我们通过I2P数据集的4 703个提示来评价裸体和暴力消除情况,并报告各自在MS-COCO上的FID和CLIP分数,以测试公用设施保存情况。 介绍原始基准模型的结果供参考。

blocks.en: Concept Erasure. We first evaluate on NSFW erasure, a well-established benchmark for model safety. We assess our localization framework using 4,703 prompts from the Inappropriate Image Prompt (I2P) dataset Schramowski et al. (2023) , focusing on nudity and violence . For nudity detection, we utilize NudeNet Bedapudi (2019) with a threshold of 0.6 . For violence, we employ the Q16-classifier Schramowski et al. (2022) . To evaluate the impact on benign content, we randomly select 10,000 captions from the MS-COCO dataset Lin et al. (2014) and measure the preservation of general generation capabilities using FID Heusel et al. (2017) and CLIP Radford et al. (2021) scores.
blocks.zh: 概念Erasure。 我们首先评估NSFW的去除,这是公认的示范安全基准。 我们利用来自不适当图像提示(I2P)数据集Schramowski等人(2023年)的4,703个提示来评估本地化框架, 在裸体检测方面,我们使用NudeNet Bedapudi(2019年)的阈值为0.6. 对于暴力,我们使用Q16分类器Schramowski等人(2022年). 为了评价对良性内容的影响,我们随机从MS-COCO数据集Lin等人(2014年)中选择了10,000个标题,并使用FID Heusel等人(2017年)和CLIP Radford等人(2021年)的分数来衡量一般生成能力的保存.

blocks.en: Table 1 and Figure 3 summarize the comparison between LoCo and state-of-the-art baselines. In nudity erasure, our method achieves the second-lowest detection rate, surpassed only by CAT. However, CAT achieves this through extreme over-purification, and it frequently collapses to generating generic clothed figures regardless of the prompt, resulting in poor utility. In contrast, LoCo maintains strong utility preservation with FID and CLIP scores nearly identical to the base models. Notably, our method ranks first in violence erasure across both Infinity and HunyuanImage-3.0. These results demonstrate that by targeting localized concept routes, LoCo establishes a remarkable balance between effective NSFW removal and the preservation of high-fidelity visual synthesis.
blocks.zh: 表1和图3概述了LoCo与最新基线的比较。 在裸体消除过程中,我们的方法实现了第二低的检测率,仅被CAT所超越. 然而,《禁止酷刑公约》通过极端的过度净化来实现这一点,它往往不惜迅速生成普通的布料数字,导致效用差。 相比之下,LoCo公司与FID和CLIP的分数几乎与基准型号相同,保持了强大的效用保全. 值得注意的是,我们的方法在消除无穷和Hunyuanimage-3.0的暴力中名列前茅。 这些结果表明,LoCo通过瞄准局部概念路线,在有效的NSFW去除和高真能视觉合成的保存之间建立了显著的平衡.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison of model personalization. Left: Fine-tuning with LoCo better adheres to prompt fidelity. Right: Fine-tuning with LoCo largely preserves irrelevant visual identities (e.g., husky, golden retriever), effectively eliminating concept bleed.
blocks.zh: 图4:模式个性化定性比较. 左:与LoCo进行微调 更好地坚持即时忠诚. 对: 与LoCo的微调在很大程度上保留了无关的视觉特征(如:hussky,金取回器),有效消除了概念出血.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Quantitative comparison of model personalization. Localized fine-tuning outperforms full-tuning across all metrics, achieving higher prompt alignment and better identity preservation.
blocks.zh: 图5:模型个性化的定量比较. 本地化微调超越了所有度量衡的全调,实现了更高的即时调和,更好的身份保护.

blocks.en: Model Personalization. We evaluate model personalization on the Infinity (T2I) and InfinityStar (T2V) models following the standard DreamBooth setup Ruiz et al. (2023) . To ensure a comprehensive assessment, we test performance across the diverse contexts provided in our LoCoBench dataset. The Prompt Alignment Score utilizes CLIP to measure how accurately the generated output reflects the prompt semantics. The Identity Score is also based on CLIP, measuring how well the generated image reflects the specific subject (e.g., husky)’s visual identity.
blocks.zh: 模特个性化. 我们按照标准的 DreamBooth 设置 Ruiz et al. (2023) 来评价无极(T2I)和无极星(T2V)模型上的模型个性化. 为了确保全面评估,我们测试LoCo Bench数据集所提供的不同背景的业绩。 即时对齐分数利用 CLIP 测量生成的输出如何准确反映即时语义. 身份分数也基于CLIP,衡量生成的图像如何很好地反映特定主体(如husky)的视觉特征.

blocks.en: Figure 5 demonstrates that our localized fine-tuning consistently outperforms standard full-model updates across all metrics. Qualitative results in Figure 4 further show that on the target concept, LoCo more faithfully reflects complex stylistic prompts, such as “a [V] dog in origami style” . Crucially, it effectively prevents identity collapse for irrelevant concepts; irrelevant subjects like a husky remain largely intact. We provide the video personalization results in Figure 1 and Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 图5显示,我们本地化的微调不断超过所有指标的标准全模型更新。 图4的定性结果进一步表明,在目标概念上,LoCo更忠实地反映了复杂的花式提示,如"折纸式的[V]狗". 关键是,它能有效防止无关的概念导致身份崩溃;像huxy这样的无关主题基本上保持完好. 我们提供图1和附录D中的视频个性化结果。

blocks.en: Table 2: Quantitative evaluation of trigger-free data poisoning. Standard full-model poisoning struggles at low data ratios and degrades benign utility. By restricting updates to localized concept routes, LoCo achieves significantly higher LIR and faster convergence (lower FAE) while preserving original image quality.
blocks.zh: 表2:无触发数据中毒定量评价. 标准全模型中毒在低数据比率下挣扎并降低良性效用. LoCo通过将更新限制在本地化的概念路线上,实现了显著更高的LIR和更快的聚合(更低的FAE),同时保留了原始的图像质量.

blocks.en: Adversarial Concept Injection. We evaluate the vulnerability of VAR models to trigger-free data poisoning, following the setup of previous work Jang et al. (2025) . Specifically, we embed target payloads (including unseen synthetic designs and real-world brands like Meta and NVIDIA) into a small fraction (e.g., 10% and 25%) of high-quality training images sourced from a 3,000-image subset of the Midjourney-v6 Foundation (2024) dataset. We measure attack effectiveness using the Logo Inclusion Rate (LIR) across 100 unseen evaluation prompts, alongside the First-Attack Epoch (FAE) to quantify learning efficiency Jang et al. (2025) . Crucially, a successful stealthy attack must also maintain the model’s original generation capabilities, which we strictly assess via FID and CLIP scores on benign prompts.
blocks.zh: 逆相概念注射. 我们评价VAR模型在前作Jang等人(2025年)设定后,无触发数据中毒的脆弱性. 具体来说,我们把目标有效载荷(包括未见的合成设计和Meta和NVIDIA等现实世界品牌)嵌入从Midjourney-v6基金会(2024年)的一个3000-image子集(2024年)数据集中产生的一小部分(如10%和25%)高质量训练图像. 我们利用LOGO包含率(LIR)测量攻击效果, 关键是,成功的隐形攻击还必须保持模型的原始生成能力,我们通过FID和CLIP在良性提示上得分来严格评估这种能力。

blocks.en: Table 2 reveals a critical security vulnerability: localized routes can be severely exploited. Standard full-model poisoning requires high data ratios and extended training, which inevitably degrades benign utility. In contrast, restricting malicious updates strictly to the top- K K concept routes achieves significantly higher Logo Inclusion Rates (LIR) at a much earlier First-Attack Epoch (FAE), requiring much less computation. As shown in Figure 1 , our localized injection successfully embeds unauthorized brands without distorting the surrounding scene. This proves that concept routes act as high-leverage bottlenecks for both model defense and malicious exploitation.
blocks.zh: 表2显示安全方面极为脆弱:局部路线可被严重利用。 标准全模型中毒需要高数据比和扩展训练,这不可避免地会降低良性效用. 相形之下,严格将恶意更新限制在上-K概念路由上,在更早的"一击Epoch"(FAE)实现显著更高的Logo兼容率(LIR),更不需要计算. 如图1所示,我们的局部注射成功嵌入了未经授权的品牌而不会扭曲周围的场景. 这证明,概念路线是模式防御和恶意剥削的高杠杆瓶颈。

Left: Dimensional ablation demonstrates that combining Layer, Scale, and Position is strictly necessary to balance erasure and image quality, while being highly parameter-efficient. Right: Sweeping the Top- K K reveals the trade-off between concept suppression, utility preservation, and training cost (measured on a single H20 GPU).
blocks.zh: 表3:I2P的读取研究. 左:维度衰减表明,结合地层,尺度,和位置对于平衡去除和图像质量是绝对必要的,同时具有高参数效率. 对: 扫荡Top-K K揭示了概念压制、公用设施保存和培训成本(用一个H20 GPU衡量)之间的取舍。

blocks.en: Sparsity of Intervention and Efficiency. We sweep the intervention ratio K ∈ { 1 % , 3 % , 5 % , 10 % } K\in\{1\%,3\%,5\%,10\%\} to strictly control the affected routing capacity. As shown in Table 3 (right) and Figure 6 (left), a highly sparse intervention ( K = 1 % K=1\% ) better preserves benign utility but suffers from concept leakage. Conversely, an aggressive K = 10 % K=10\% eradicates the target but disrupts the discrete token space, causing noticeable collateral damage to prompt alignment. Crucially, compared to standard full-model fine-tuning, our optimal K = 5 % K=5\% setting achieves superior concept suppression while reducing VRAM usage (GB) by 38.5% and training time (min) by 82.9%.
blocks.zh: 干预和效率的均等。 我们扫清干预比率K {{1%, 3%, 5%, 10%} K\in {1}} 3}}} 5} 10} 严格控制受影响的路由能力。 如表3(右)和图6(左)所示,非常稀少的干预(K=1%K=1++)更好地维护良性效用,但有概念漏洞。 反之,激进的K = 10% K = 10 Q 消除了目标,但干扰了离散的符号空间,对迅速对接造成了明显的附带损害。 关键是,与标准全模型微调相比,我们的最佳K= 5%的K=5+Q设定实现了优越的概念抑制,同时将VRAM(GB)的使用率减少38.5%,将培训时间(min)减少82.9%.

blocks.en: Dimensionality of Routing. Table 3 (left) isolates our localization dimensions. Updating only by Layer or Scale fails significantly: it blindly suppresses global parameters, leading to either severe concept leakage or utility collapse, while still consuming unnecessary memory. While combining Layer and Scale improves performance, it lacks spatial precision. Introducing the Position dimension is strictly necessary. This Layer-Scale-Position routing aligns naturally with the model’s native coarse-to-fine dynamics, enabling precise concept isolation without catastrophic forgetting.
blocks.zh: 游走的维度。 表3(左)隔离了我们本地化的维度. 仅由图层或缩放进行更新严重失败:它盲目地压制了全局参数,导致严重的概念泄漏或效用崩溃,同时仍然消耗不必要的内存. 虽然结合了地层和尺度提高了性能,但缺乏空间精度. 引入职位层面是绝对必要的。 这个层层-规模-前景的路由自然地与模型的原生粗糙到精细的动态一致,能够精确的概念隔离而不造成灾难性的忘记。

blocks.en: Prevention of Spatial Overfitting. Figure 6 (right) visualizes our per-scale localization maps. For concepts like nudity, the aggregated heatmap often outlines a human silhouette. Crucially, this does not imply that LoCo overfits to specific spatial pixels. Our empirical probing reveals that an overwhelming 94.7% of the targeted concept signals are actively intercepted within the critical layers of the first two coarse scales, long before any fine-grained spatial layout materializes. The localized positions at later, high-resolution scales serve only as high-precision safety refinements guided by the model’s inherent visual priors. This confirms that our framework suppresses fundamental semantic routes rather than blindly memorizing localized artifact patterns. For more ablations on the intrinsic causality and structural invariance of our localized routes, please see Appendix D.3 .
blocks.zh: 防止空间过度适应。 图6(右)可视化我们每个比例的本地化地图. 对于裸体这样的概念,集合热图常常会勾勒出一个人类的圆筒. 关键是,这并不意味着LoCo对特定空间像素的过度. 我们的经验调查显示,在最初两个粗糙尺度的关键层中,在任何精细的空间布局出现之前,94.7%的目标概念信号被积极截获。 后期的局部位置,高分辨尺度,只是以模型固有的视觉前身为取向的高精度安全改进. 这证实了我们的框架压制了基本的语义路线,而不是盲目地去纪念局部的文物形态. 关于我们本地化路线的内在因果关系和结构变化,请见附录D.3。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic concept localization framework for next-scale autoregressive models. By exploiting native coarse-to-fine dynamics, LoCo precisely maps concept routes across Layer, Scale, and Position. With the comprehensive LoCoBench dataset, we demonstrate the immense utility of our framework in concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial injection. Restricting intervention strictly to targeted concept routes achieves superior task effectiveness, while also preserving generation quality and reducing computation. We hope this work establishes a foundation for interpretable, controllable, and efficient autoregressive generation.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了LoCo,这是下个尺度自递模型的第一个模型-不可知概念本地化框架. LoCo精确地绘制了跨越地层、尺度和位置的概念路线。 有了全面的LoCo Bench数据集,我们展示了我们的框架在概念消除、模型个性化和对抗性注射方面的巨大作用。 严格将干预限制在目标概念路线上,可以实现更高的任务效能,同时也能保持生成质量并减少计算. 我们希望这项工作为可解释、可控制和高效的自动递减生成奠定基础。

blocks.en: Appendix B LoCoBench Dataset
blocks.zh: 附录B LoCo Bench 数据集

blocks.en: In this section, we detail the construction and composition of our proposed benchmark, LoCoBench , designed to systematically evaluate concept routing and localization in VAR models. To comprehensively cover a wide spectrum of visual and semantic knowledge, LoCoBench is organized around 10 distinct categories: Animals (e.g., “a buffalo”), Artists (e.g., “A.Y. Jackson”), Brands (e.g., “Nike”), Celebrities (e.g., “Taylor Swift”), Copyrighted Characters (e.g., “the Harry Potter”), Famous Places (e.g., “the Pyramids of Giza”), Safety (e.g., “a topless woman”), Artistic Styles (e.g., “origami style”), Substances (e.g., “morphine”), and Weapons (e.g., “a sniper rifle”). These categories are meticulously selected to reflect the most critical real-world use cases for model unlearning (e.g., removing harmful substances, weapons, or copyrighted content), model personalization (e.g., injecting specific brands or styles), and adversarial interventions.

blocks.en: To construct the target knowledge entities for each category, we employed a hybrid curation strategy. For the Artists category, we sampled prominent names from WikiArt [ 60 ] Artists dataset. For the remaining categories, we utilized state-of-the-art large language models (e.g., GPT-4o [ 30 ] ) to generate representative and diverse lists of concept entities, initialized via a few-shot prompting setup to ensure high relevance and visual distinctiveness.
blocks.zh: 为了为每个类别建立目标知识实体,我们采用了混合管理战略。 对于"艺术家"类别,我们从WikiArt[60] Artists data set中抽取了显著的名字. 对于其余的类别,我们利用最先进的大型语言模式(如:GPT-4o [30])来生成具有代表性和多样性的概念实体清单,通过几发催化设置来初始化,以确保高度相关性和视觉特性.

blocks.en: Following the curation of the 1,467 concept entities, prompt augmentation are similarly performed using GPT-4o. For each target entity, we prompted the LLM to generate diverse, semantically meaningful text descriptions suitable for generative models. We systematically varied backgrounds, lighting conditions, camera angles, and contextual interactions to ensure that the autoregressive models are evaluated on robust and diverse scenarios rather than memorized, fixed templates.
blocks.zh: 在管理了1 467个概念实体之后,同样使用GPT-4o进行快速增强。 对于每个目标实体,我们促使LLM生成出适合基因模型的多样的,精密有意义的文字描述. 我们系统化地不同背景、照明条件、相机角度和背景互动,以确保自动递归模型在强而多样的情景下得到评价,而不是记住固定的模板。

blocks.en: We define concept erasure as the task of removing a specific target concept from a generative model, ensuring that the model can no longer synthesize images corresponding to that concept. Since retraining the model from scratch on a filtered dataset is impractical and computationally expensive, we aim to directly modify the model’s behavior through minimal and targeted interventions. A key challenge in this process is ensuring that unlearning a target concept does not degrade performance on semantically related concepts or compromise general generation capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们把消除概念定义为从基因模型中去除特定目标概念的任务,确保模型不再能合成与这一概念相适应的图像. 由于将模型从头到尾地再培训在被过滤的数据集上是不切实际的,而且计算成本很高,因此我们的目标是通过最小和有针对性的干预来直接修改模型的行为。 这一进程的一个关键挑战是确保不学习一个目标概念不会降低与具体相关概念的性能或损害一般生成能力。

blocks.en: To achieve this, we follow the erasure framework proposed in prior works [ 34 ] , assuming access to a target concept (e.g., “The Batman” ) and an anchor concept (e.g., “a character” ). The anchor concept is a broader category that serves as a neutral replacement for the target, preserving the contextual meaning of the original prompt while abstracting away the specific identity. Our objective is to align the output distribution of the target concept with that of the anchor concept. We formulate this concept erasure across two distinct paradigms: a training-free inference intervention and a targeted fine-tuning approach.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一点,我们遵循了前作中提议的去除框架[34],假设可以访问目标概念(如"蝙蝠侠")和锚地概念(如"人物"). 主机概念是一个更广泛的类别,它充当了目标的中性替代,保留了原始快取的上下文意义,同时抽象出特定的身份. 我们的目标是使目标概念的产出分布与锚地概念相一致。 我们从两个不同的范式出发消除这一概念:无培训推论干预和有针对性的微调方法。

blocks.en: C.2 Model Personalization
blocks.zh: C.2 型号个性化

blocks.en: Given only a few casually captured images (typically 3 to 5) of a specific subject, model personalization aims to synthesize high-fidelity images of that subject in novel scenes. These prompt-driven variations may involve changes in location, appearance, pose, viewpoint, and other semantic attributes. The objective is to implant a new subject into the vocabulary of the generative model. This process must preserve the visual identity of the subject while maintaining the broader compositional generation capabilities of the model.
blocks.zh: 模型个性化只考虑到一个特定主题的少数随机捕捉到的图像(典型的为3至5),旨在将这个主题的高真实度图像综合入新作场景. 这些即时驱动的变化可能涉及位置、外观、姿势、观点和其他语义属性的变化。 目标是将一个新学科植入基因模型的词汇中. 这一过程必须保持主体的视觉特征,同时保持模型更广泛的组成生成能力.

blocks.en: To avoid the overhead of manually writing detailed descriptions for each reference image, we adopt the standard labeling scheme introduced by DreamBooth [ 49 ] . Each input image is annotated with a specific phrase, such as “a [identifier] [class noun]” . Here, [identifier] is a unique token assigned to the new subject (e.g., “[V]” ), and [class noun] is a coarse semantic category describing the subject (e.g., “dog” or “car” ). This setup allows the model to leverage its strong prior knowledge for the specified class while learning a new specific embedding for the subject identifier.
blocks.zh: 为避免人工为每个参考图像写出详细描述的间接费用,我们采用DreamBooth[49]引入的标准标签方案. 每个输入图像都附有一个具体短语,例如“[识别 [类名词]”。 这里,[识别符]是指定给新主体(如""("V")")的独特标志,而[类名词]是描述该主体(如"狗"或"车")的粗糙语义类. 这种设置允许模型在为主题标识器学习新的特定嵌入时,利用其对指定类的强先知识.

Full-parameter updates on small datasets disrupt unrelated semantic pathways. This significantly degrades the prompt alignment capabilities of the model in complex novel scenarios and incurs immense computational overhead, as shown in Figure 4 .

Before fine-tuning, we probe the frozen original model with the base class noun y class y^{\text{class}} . We extract its localization map to identify the top- K K layer-scale-position routes responsible for rendering this specific semantic category.

However, we restrict the backpropagation and parameter updates exclusively to these highly relevant localized routes, denoted as θ K ∗ \theta^{*}_{K} . The vast majority of the model weights remain completely frozen. This ultra-sparse intervention binds the new identifier exactly where the model naturally processes that category. Consequently, our localized personalization drastically reduces VRAM usage, completely prevents the degradation of prior knowledge, and achieves superior subject fidelity in complex novel contexts.

blocks.en: C.3 Adversarial Concept Injection
blocks.zh: C.3 横向概念注射

blocks.en: Adversarial concept injection explores the vulnerabilities of generative models against malicious manipulation. A prominent example is the silent branding attack [ 31 ] . Attackers aim to embed hidden payloads, such as unauthorized brand logos, watermarks, or unsafe cues, into the model through data poisoning. The ultimate goal is to force the model to generate these specific concepts naturally within relevant contexts, even without any explicit text triggers.
blocks.zh: 反常的概念注入探索了基因模型抵御恶意操纵的脆弱性. 一个突出的例子是无声品牌攻击 [31]. 攻击者旨在通过数据中毒将未经批准的品牌标志、水印或不安全提示等隐藏的有效载荷嵌入模型。 最终目标是迫使该模型在相关背景下自然生成这些具体概念,即使没有任何明确的文本触发因素.

blocks.en: However, updating the entire architecture θ \theta presents significant drawbacks for the attacker. Full-parameter fine-tuning is highly data-hungry and computationally expensive. More importantly, it inevitably disrupts the benign generative capabilities of the model. This global degradation introduces noticeable visual artifacts and stylistic shifts. Such collateral damage makes the backdoor highly conspicuous and easily identifiable by standard security filters.
blocks.zh: 然而,更新整个架构 \\theta 给攻击者带来重大缺陷。 全参数微调数据要求高,计算成本高. 更重要的是,它不可避免地会打乱模型的良性遗传能力. 这种全球退化带来了显著的视觉文物和结构转变。 这种附带损害使后门非常明显,而且很容易被标准的安全过滤器所识别。

blocks.en: Localized Stealthy Injection via Top-K Routes. Our LoCo framework provides a principled method to execute highly stealthy and data-efficient injections. Instead of treating the target model as a black box, we utilize our framework to pinpoint its exact structural vulnerabilities. Before the attack, we probe the frozen model with the target context (e.g., “a coffee cup” if the goal is to inject a specific coffee brand logo). We extract the localization map to identify the top- K K layer-scale-position routes that are most responsive to this specific context.
blocks.zh: 通过Top-K路进行本地化隐形注射. 我们的LoCo框架提供了一种原则性的方法,可以进行高度隐蔽和数据效率高的注射. 我们不把目标模式当作一个黑匣子,而是利用我们的框架确定它的确切结构弱点。 在攻击前,我们用目标上下文来探究被冻结的模型(例如,如果目标是注入特定的咖啡品牌标志的话,“一个咖啡杯”。 我们提取出本地化地图,以识别最能适应这种特定背景的上-K地层相位路线.

blocks.en: During the data poisoning process, we compute the standard injection loss ℒ inject \mathcal{L}_{\text{inject}} . However, we restrict the backpropagation strictly to these highly localized routes, denoted as θ K ∗ \theta^{*}_{K} . The rest of the model architecture remains entirely frozen.
blocks.zh: 在数据中毒过程中, 我们计算标准注射损失 L 注射 \ mathcal{ L}_{\text{ inject} 。 然而,我们仅限于这些高度本地化的路线, 表示为-K *\theta^{*}_{K}。 其余的模型建筑仍然完全被冻结.

blocks.en: This ultra-sparse parameter update forcefully embeds the malicious payload exactly where the model naturally processes the relevant semantic context. Consequently, our localized injection achieves a near-perfect attack success rate with minimal poisoned data. It perfectly preserves the original image quality and ensures the backdoor remains completely hidden during benign generation. This downstream application proves that concept routes act as fundamental structural bottlenecks. They can be neutralized for safety alignments or exploited to expose critical generative vulnerabilities.
blocks.zh: 这种超散射参数的更新有力地将恶意有效载荷嵌入到模型自然处理相关语义上下文的地方。 因此,我们的局部注射取得了几乎完美的攻击成功率,只有最低的毒性数据。 它完美地保存了原始的图像质量,并确保了后门在良性生成时完全被隐藏. 这种下游应用证明了概念路线是根本性的结构瓶颈。 它们可以因安全调整而被抵消,或者被利用来暴露关键的基因脆弱性。

blocks.en: Here, we discuss adaptations of baselines in detail. Most existing concept erasure methods were originally designed for continuous diffusion models or flow-matching architectures. In those paradigms, the optimization objective relies on modifying the predicted continuous noise or vector fields. However, next-scale VAR models operate by predicting discrete tokens in a probability space. To ensure a fair and rigorous comparison, we adapt these baselines to the VAR architecture by reformulating their noise-prediction objectives into next-scale probability alignment objectives. Furthermore, to prevent the severe error accumulation and generation collapse inherent to autoregressive decoding, we provide all baselines with the auxiliary frozen tokens r < s neutral r_{<s}^{\text{neutral}} generated by the original model, following the conditional alignment strategy discussed in Section 4 .

blocks.en: While our main results demonstrate the downstream effectiveness of targeted interventions, this section provides deeper evidence that our ( 𝙻𝚊𝚢𝚎𝚛 , 𝚂𝚌𝚊𝚕𝚎 , 𝙿𝚘𝚜𝚒𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗 ) \mathtt{(Layer,Scale,Position)} triplets represent the fundamental causal routes of concepts. We verify this through counterfactual interventions, stability analysis across contexts, and a comparison with exhaustive search.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的主要结果表明目标干预的下游效力,但本节提供了更深入的证据表明,我们的(层、尺度、位置)\matht{(Layer, Scale, Position)] 三重性是概念的基本因果途径。 我们通过反事实干预、不同背景的稳定分析,以及与详尽调查的比较,来核实这一点。

blocks.en: Causal Intervention via Bottom-K and Random-K. To prove that our localized routes are the causal bottlenecks for concept emergence, we compare our Top-5% intervention against two control groups. First, the Bottom-5% strategy intervenes on positions with the lowest attention responses. Second, the Random-5% strategy selects positions randomly across all layers and scales. We evaluate these on the concept erasure task.
blocks.zh: 通过下-K和随机-K进行因果关系干预。 为了证明我们本地化的路线是概念出现的因果瓶颈,我们比较了我们Top-5%的干预和两个控制组. 首先,下层-5%战略对关注度最低的职位进行干预。 第二,"随机-5%"策略在各个层次和尺度随机选择位置. 我们在概念消除任务中评估这些内容。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , intervening on the Bottom-5% positions results in zero concept suppression, with Target CLIP scores remaining nearly identical to the base model (0.282 vs. 0.284 on Infinity). Conversely, while Random-5% intervention slightly reduces the target concept, it causes a severe drop in Background CLIP and image fidelity (from 0.312 to 0.264). In contrast, our Targeted Top-5% achieves the lowest Target CLIP (0.185) while maintaining perfect background preservation (0.311). This explicitly demonstrates that concept routing in VAR models is highly localized. Successful intervention depends strictly on identifying these specific causal routes rather than simple parameter sparsity.
blocks.zh: 如表6所示,在最低-5%的位置上进行干预会导致零概念压制,目标CLIP得分与基准模式(0.282对0.284对无穷)几乎相同。 相反,虽然随机-5%的干预略微减少目标概念,但导致背景CLIP和图像忠贞度严重下降(从0.312降至0.264)。 相反,我们的目标最高-5%达到最低目标CLIP(0.185),同时保持完美的背景保护(0.311)。 这清楚地表明,VAR模型中的概念路由高度本地化。 成功的干预严格取决于确定这些具体的因果路径,而不是简单的参数sparsity.

blocks.en: Table 6: Causal Verification via Counterfactual Interventions. Metrics are averaged over 500 prompts for concept erasure from LoCoBench. Targeted Top-5% intervention is strictly necessary to achieve significant concept erasure (Target CLIP ↓ \downarrow ) without compromising background utility (Background CLIP ↑ \uparrow ).
blocks.zh: 表6:通过反事实干预进行因果关系核查。 来自LoCo Bench的计量平均有500多个消除概念的提示。 目标Top-5%的干预对于实现重大的概念去除(目标CLIP QQ \ downarrow )而不损害背景工具(背景CLIP QQ\ oparrow )是绝对必要的.

blocks.en: Cross-Context Stability of Concept Routes. A key property of a structural route is its invariance across different generation trajectories. We measure the stability of our localized triplets by calculating the Intersection over Union (IoU %) of the Top-5% positions across 100 random seeds (Cross-Seed) and 20 diverse prompts per concept (Cross-Prompt).
blocks.zh: 概念路线的跨文本稳定性. 结构路由的关键属性是它在不同世代的轨迹之间变化不定. 我们通过计算100个随机种子(Cross-Seed)的顶-5%位置的交叉(IoU%)和每个概念(Cross-Prompt)的20个不同的提示(Cross-Prompt)来测量本地化三胞胎的稳定性.

blocks.en: The results in Table 7 show that the identified routes are remarkably stable. The average Cross-Seed IoU reaches 89.4%, proving that concept emergence is a deterministic property of the network architecture rather than an artifact of specific noise. Furthermore, the high Cross-Prompt IoU (83.4%) confirms that a specific concept (e.g., “Nudity” ) consistently utilizes the same neural pathways regardless of the surrounding textual context. In contrast, the IoU between two entirely different concepts (Cross-Concept) is less than 5%, highlighting the extreme specificity of our localized routes.
blocks.zh: 表7的结果显示,所确定的路线非常稳定。 平均Cross-Seed IoU达到89.4%,证明了概念的出现是网络架构的决定性属性,而不是有特定噪音的文物. 此外,高跨Prompt IoU(83.4%)证实,一个具体的概念(如“裸体”)无论周围文字背景如何,始终使用相同的神经途径。 相比之下,两个完全不同的概念(Cross-Concept)之间的IoU不到5%,凸显出我们本地化路线的极端特异性.

blocks.en: Table 7: Structural Stability and Specificity. We report the Jaccard Similarity (IoU %) of localized Top-5% triplets. High Cross-Seed and Cross-Prompt stability, combined with low Cross-Concept overlap, confirms that our method identifies unique and invariant neural bottlenecks.
blocks.zh: 表7:结构稳定性和具体性。 我们报告本地化Top-5%三胞胎的Jaccard相似性(IoU%)。 高跨种子和跨Prompt稳定性,与低跨概念重叠相结合,证实我们的方法识别出独特而无常的神经瓶颈.

blocks.en: Comparison with Brute-Force Localization. To further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of our attention-based localization, we compare it against a brute-force search baseline. In a next-scale VAR model with L L layers, S S scales, and P P spatial positions per scale, the search space for the optimal sparse positions is combinatorial and computationally intractable. For a tractable comparison, we implemented a macroscopic brute-force baseline that exhaustively evaluates all L × S L\times S layer-scale blocks to find the optimal intervention region.
blocks.zh: 与Brute-Force本地化比较. 为了进一步证明我们基于注意力的本地化的效率和可靠性,我们把它与野蛮力量搜索基线进行比较。 在下个具有L L层,S平面,和P平面空间位置的VAR模型中,对最优化的稀有位置的搜索空间是组合并难以计算. 为了进行可操作的比较,我们采用了一个宏观的畜力基线,该基线详尽地评估了所有L×S L\times S分层块,以找到最佳干预区域。

blocks.en: Our method identifies the targeted concept routes in a single forward pass by aggregating the internal attention responses. In contrast, the brute-force baseline requires evaluating every candidate block independently. Consequently, for a standard VAR architecture, our approach offers a strict 𝒪 ( L × S ) × \mathcal{O}(L\times S)\times speedup during the localization phase.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法通过汇总内部关注对策,确定目标概念路径。 相比之下,野蛮部队的基线要求独立评估每个候选区块。 因此,对于标准的VAR架构,我们的方法在本地化阶段提供了严格的O (L × S )\ mathcal{O}(L\times S)\time.

blocks.en: Despite this massive reduction in search cost, our localized fine-tuning achieves highly comparable results to the optimal brute-force solution. On the concept erasure task, the computationally expensive brute-force optimal region resulted in a Target CLIP score drop of 0.102 (from 0.284 to 0.182). Our single-pass localization method achieved a nearly identical Target CLIP drop of 0.099 (from 0.284 to 0.185) while strictly maintaining the same level of background preservation. These results systematically confirm that internal attention dynamics provide a highly reliable and maximally efficient signal for pinpointing concept bottlenecks, entirely eliminating the need for exhaustive search.
blocks.zh: 尽管搜索费用大幅降低,但我们的局部微调取得了与最佳野蛮武力解决方案高度相仿的结果。 在概念消除任务方面,计算成本昂贵的畜力最佳区域导致目标CLIP得分下降0.102分(从0.284分降至0.182分). 我们的单通本地化方法实现了几乎相同的目标CLIP下降0.099(从0.284降至0.185),同时严格保持了相同的背景保存水平. 这些成果系统地证实,内部关注动态为确定概念瓶颈提供了高度可靠和最高效的信号,从而完全不需要详尽无遗的搜索。

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: Our LoCo framework successfully localizes conceptual knowledge across Layer, Scale, and Position dimensions. This structured localization is highly effective and enables ultra-sparse targeted interventions for downstream applications. However, our current approach relies on an empirically chosen sparsity threshold (e.g., the top-5% of routed positions). We determine this optimal capacity based on external evaluation metrics like CLIP scores and downstream task performance. The framework does not currently calculate the absolute minimum capacity required for a specific concept automatically. Different concepts may inherently require varying route capacities depending on their visual complexity. A promising future direction is to dynamically estimate the optimal sparsity level K K for each concept using purely internal model signals. For example, future methods could leverage the entropy or peak sharpness of the attention response map without requiring external evaluation feedback.
blocks.zh: 我们的LoCo框架成功地将各种层、尺度和位置层面的概念知识本地化。 这种结构化的本地化非常有效,能够对下游应用进行超分散的有针对性干预。 然而,我们目前的做法依赖于经验性选择的Sparsity阈值(例如路由位置的前5%). 我们根据诸如CLIP分数和下游任务业绩等外部评价衡量标准确定这一最佳能力。 该框架目前没有自动计算特定概念所需的绝对最低容量。 不同的概念可能必然需要不同的路由能力,视其视觉复杂性而定。 一个有希望的未来方向是用纯粹的内部模型信号,对每个概念的最好的Spersity级K进行动态估计. 例如,未来的方法可以利用注意力响应图的等效或峰值锐度,而不需要外部评价反馈.

blocks.en: Additionally, while our LoCoBench dataset and counterfactual experiments rigorously validate the causality of these localized routes, the deep semantic entanglement in large-scale generative models presents an ongoing challenge. Highly correlated concepts may naturally share overlapping neural pathways. This makes perfectly disjoint localization difficult for highly compositional prompts. Developing synthetic model architectures with mathematically known structural ground truths could further strengthen the validation of future interpretability and routing disentanglement methods.
blocks.zh: 此外,虽然我们的LoCo Bench数据集和反事实实验严格验证了这些局部路径的因果关系,但大规模基因模型中的深层语义缠绕仍是一个持续的挑战。 高度相关的概念自然可能具有重叠的神经途径。 这使得对于高度成分化的提示来说,完全脱节的本地化是困难的. 开发带有数学上已知的结构地真能的合成模型架构,可以进一步加强对未来可解释性和路由分解方法的验证.

blocks.en: Appendix F Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 附录F 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work is conducted for academic research on the interpretability and controllability of modern generative models. Our central goal is to understand how visual concepts are routed inside next-scale autoregressive architectures, and to provide a principled way to analyze where and when specific concepts emerge during generation. We believe that such understanding is important for building generative systems that are more transparent, more controllable, and better aligned with safety and compliance requirements.
blocks.zh: 这项工作是为了研究现代基因模型的可解释性和可控制性。 我们的中心目标是了解视觉概念如何被引导到下个尺度的自相递进结构中,并提供一个原则性的方法来分析特定概念在一代人的时间和地点。 我们认为,这种理解对于建立更透明、更可控制、更符合安全和遵守要求的基因系统十分重要。

blocks.en: The proposed framework is designed to support responsible model adaptation. By localizing concept-related routes across layers, scales, and positions, LoCo enables targeted interventions that modify only a small and relevant part of the generation process. This helps reduce unnecessary changes to benign model behavior while improving control over specific concepts. In this sense, our method contributes to safer and more reliable deployment of generative models, especially when models need to respect content policies, copyright constraints, or application-specific requirements.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架旨在支持负责任的模型适应。 LoCo通过将与概念有关的路线定位到不同层次、尺度和位置,使目标明确的干预能够仅修改生成过程的一小部分相关部分。 这有助于减少对良性模型行为的不必要的改变,同时改进对特定概念的控制. 从这个意义上讲,我们的方法有助于更安全和更可靠的基因模型的部署,特别是在模型需要尊重内容政策,版权限制,或应用特定要求时.

blocks.en: All datasets and experiments in this paper are used only for research and evaluation purposes. The concept categories in LoCoBench are constructed to study model behavior under diverse semantic settings, rather than to encourage any harmful use. Our results are intended to provide technical insights for the community and to help future work develop more interpretable, compliant, and controllable generative architectures.
blocks.zh: 本文中的所有数据集和实验只用于研究和评价目的. LoCo Bench的概念类别是用来研究不同语义环境中的模型行为,而不是鼓励任何有害的使用. 我们的成果旨在为社区提供技术洞察力,并帮助未来工作发展更能解释、更能适应和控制的基因结构。

blocks.en: NeurIPS Paper Checklist
blocks.zh: 神经病 纸张核对表

blocks.en: 1. Claims Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The claims we presented in the abstract and introduction are clearly stated and fully aligned with the contributions of this paper. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper. • The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers. • The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings. • It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper. 2. Limitations Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors? Answer: [Yes] Justification: We discuss the limitations in Appendix E . Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper. • The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper. • The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be. • The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated. • The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon. • The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size. • If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness. • While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations. 3. Theory assumptions and proofs Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof? Answer: [N/A] Justification: None of theoretical assumptions. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results. • All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced. • All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems. • The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition. • Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material. • Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced. 4. Experimental result reproducibility Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)? Answer: [Yes] Justification: We provide all necessary implementation details required to reproduce the main experimental results in Appendix D.1 to ensure reproducibility. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not. • If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable. • Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed. • While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example (a) If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm. (b) If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully. (c) If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset). (d) We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results. 5. Open access to data and code Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material? Answer: [Yes] Justification: We will publicly release the code and data once they have been finalized and properly prepared for distribution. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that paper does not include experiments requiring code. • Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details. • While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark). • The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details. • The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc. • The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why. • At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable). • Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted. 6. Experimental setting/details Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results? Answer: [Yes] Justification: We provide all relevant experimental details such as dataset setup, evaluation procedures, and experimental conditions in Sec 5.1 and the appendix, sufficient for understanding and reproducing the results. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them. • The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material. 7. Experiment statistical significance Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments? Answer: [No] Justification: The experiments statistics are precisely run with given experimental conditions. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • The authors should answer [Yes] if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper. • The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions). • The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.) • The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors). • It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean. • It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified. • For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates). • If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text. 8. Experiments compute resources Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments? Answer: [Yes] Justification: See Sec. 5.3 . Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage. • The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute. • The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper). 9. Code of ethics Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The research presented in this paper fully complies with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics. • If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics. • The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction). 10. Broader impacts Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed? Answer: [Yes] Justification: We briefly discuss potential impacts of our work in the conclusion section. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed. • If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact. • Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations. • The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster. • The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology. • If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML). 11. Licenses for existing assets Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected? Answer: [Yes] Justification: All external assets used in this work are properly credited with citations. We respect all applicable licenses and terms, which are explicitly mentioned where relevant. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets. • The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset. • The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL. • The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset. • For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided. • If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided.
